papers.review_note: All 100 questions (printed pages 3–31) were visually compared against the original November 2023 bilingual Paper-II scan. OCR/field issues were corrected where source-supported. papers.answer_key_audit_note: All 100 stored answer/official_answer letters were compared against the corresponding official final answer-key PDF; 0 letter mismatches. Question wording/options and source-page visual fidelity remain separate review gates.
